# #2793: Patch: card animations for the Core set
Opened by @MaxGoetzmann.

## What it does

This part fills in the Core set's card animation table, `apps/web/src/fx/cards/core.json5` (#2784), for #2782.

Core has 100 cards (`core-001` to `core-100`) and 11 tokens:

- 63 are Spells, Field Spells, Traps or Field Traps; 16 of them are Field Spells.
- 25 are Units with a Cry, Death, trigger or Activate in their text.

Today almost every Core entry is `"none: pending"`. Hinder (core-021), Blood Ridden Glowy Jelly Bean (core-027) and Ceaseless Void (core-100) are already bespoke.

Read `docs/polish/9-card-animations.md` and `docs/issues-and-patches.md`'s "A task over every card" first. This is a pass over every card.

### The measure

- **Spells and Traps.** Every Spell, Field Spell, Trap and Field Trap gets a motif, or a bespoke key, on its `cast` hook.
- **Units with hooks.** Every Unit whose Cry, Death, trigger or Activate changes the board gets a motif on that hook. A hook with no visible outcome may be `"none: <reason>"`.
- **Field Spells.** Every Field Spell also gets an `aura` entry (#2787 draws it).
- **Plain Units.** A vanilla Unit may be `"none: vanilla"`.
- **Tokens.** A token gets an entry only where it earns one.
- **Picking a motif.** Pick from `cargo jackioh fx census` (#2788) for Core, never from comparing card texts. Override the census's suggestion only with a reason in the table.
- **Palette.** Use a sub-look (#2792) wherever two neighbouring cards of one flavor would otherwise look alike.
- **Scale.** Set it from cost and rarity, as the doc says. Don't hand-tune per card.
- **Bespoke cards.** Give 3 to 6 Core cards a bespoke Flourish (Epic, Legendary or a marquee Rare), each built from the motif primitives with no new rendering tech. Each needs a one-line reason in the PR.
- **Legendary and Mythic entrances.** #2722's entrance and takeover animations are open to change (#2782); the owner finds them weak. A Legendary's or Mythic's Flourish may restyle its own entrance, and a Mythic its own takeover look, where the shared one doesn't suit the card. Do it through this set's table and its `fx/cards/<set>/` recipes; the shared takeover and the shared Legendary entrance in `fx/takeover.ts` are #2803's to rework. Keep the music (R2722000), when and for whom an entrance plays (R2722002) and the one capped hold (R2722001, as #2785 generalizes it). Update the tests that pin what you change, and amend R2722001 in this part's ruling note. Ceaseless Void's (core-100) is #2800's.
- **New motifs.** If 3 or more cards fit no motif, add one by the doc's "When to add a motif" rule, in its own commit, rather than going bespoke card by card.
- **Set pieces.** List set-piece candidates (wipes, game-ending moments) in the PR and give them a motif for now. Twisting Nether (core-088) and Ceaseless Void (core-100) are the board-wipe part's (F) to build.

### The deliverable

The PR holds a table with one row per Core card: the id and name, each hook, the motif, palette and scale or the key or the `none` reason, the census suggestion, and why. A reviewer must be able to check every card from it.

## Acceptance

- [ ] `core.json5` gives at least 55% of Core's 100 cards (55 or more) an entry other than `none`, and every Spell, Field Spell, Trap and Field Trap has a `cast` entry. A per-set test enforces this floor.
- [ ] Every Field Spell has an `aura` entry.
- [ ] 3 to 6 bespoke Flourishes, each with a vitest pinning its cues and an R200 check, built from motif primitives.
- [ ] The PR's per-card table, generated from the census plus the overrides, covers all 100 cards.
- [ ] No hidden card keys an entry (R202). The existing Hinder, Blood Bean and Void tests still pass.
- [ ] The `/dev/fx` gallery can play every Core entry.
- [ ] Every number is a named constant (CLAUDE.md rule 9).
- [ ] Web typecheck, tests and eslint pass, and the hotseat smoke settles.

## Blocked by, part of

Blocked by #2786, #2788, #2783 and #2792. Part of #2782.
